title: A rep with the switch off is not copied but still credited at invoicing
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has {Sales-rep-B} as its one sales representative, and {Sales-rep-B}'s "Sales Representative" switch has since been turned off (the account is active).
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Starting screen: the Work Orders page is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open {Customer-A}'s page.
  2. Create a new work order for {Customer-A} with one labor line and one part.
  3. Invoice the work order without picking a representative.
  4. Open Reports > Sales By Representative for today.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Customer-A} still shows {Sales-rep-B}.
  • Step 2: the new work order's Sales Representative reads "Unassigned".
  • Step 3: the invoice is created.
  • Step 4: the invoice is credited to {Sales-rep-B}, labor and parts.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S4-R27, S4-N2, S4-R17, Story 4 context note (S4-R27, S4-N2), read 19 Oct 2026. Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), page 2 (cited by the story), export read 19 Oct 2026, used for on-screen labels; the look itself is checked in the "Design — how it looks" cases. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R27: “Only a staff member whose account is active and whose Sales Representative switch is on is copied (S1-R8). Anyone else leaves that field "Unassigned", and S4-R17 and S4-R18 still apply at invoicing.”
  • S4-N2: “Turning off a staff member's Sales Representative switch, without deactivating their account, leaves them in the customer fields they hold, as today.”
  • S4-R17: “A work order invoiced with nobody on either side is credited with the customer's Service Parts person on the parts side and the Service Labor person on the labor side. A customer that is not split gives its one person both sides.”
  • Story 4 context note (S4-R27, S4-N2): “* Context note (S4-R27, S4-N2): a person whose Sales Representative switch is off but whose account is active can stay in a customer field (S4-N2). A new work order does not copy them, so its card reads "Unassigned", but when it is invoiced with nobody on it, S4-R17 still credits them from the customer. QA should expect both.”
